description: Estudiante de Medicina Humana y creador de EscritorInfinito. Me impulsa explorar lo desconocido y convertir preguntas en conocimiento que trascienda. Con INFINITE ECHOES investigaré y narraré el legado de los equipos que permanecen en la Luna y Marte, uniendo ciencia, creatividad y comunicación. Desarrollo esta iniciativa individual con una convicción: la eternidad no está en vivir para siempre, sino en crear algo que merezca ser recordado. BEYOND TIME, BEYOND LIMITS.
summary:
INFINITE ECHOES is an immersive audiovisual project that explores the lasting legacy of humanity's space exploration missions. Through five cinematic movements and 23 scenes, it follows the scientific and human stories of the Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package (ALSEP), NASA's Opportunity rover on Mars, Voyager 1's journey into deep space, and humanity's vision of the future.

Created as an individual initiative by a Human Medicine student and the creator of EscritorInfinito, the project combines historical space imagery, clearly identified artistic recreations, original narration, cinematic soundtrack, and English subtitles to transform scientific history into an engaging storytelling experience.

Driven by curiosity and the desire to turn questions into knowledge, INFINITE ECHOES carries a simple conviction: eternity is not about living forever, but creating something worth remembering.

Beyond Time. Beyond Limits.
details:
INFINITE ECHOES is an interactive audiovisual experience that brings the history of space exploration to life through five cinematic movements and 23 scenes.

The project explores three historic missions: ALSEP and the Moon, NASA's Opportunity rover on Mars, and Voyager 1's journey into interstellar space, connecting their scientific discoveries with humanity's future.

Through an interactive web player, visitors can explore the scenes, listen to original Spanish narration, read English subtitles, and experience historical NASA/JPL photographs, artistic recreations, and cinematic sound.

Developed using Lovable, with ChatGPT supporting research, script development, and translation, the project aims to make space science accessible, inspire curiosity, and encourage future generations to explore the unknown.

Its central message is simple: every discovery leaves a legacy.

BEYOND TIME. BEYOND LIMITS.
